cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(ros2_intro)

if(CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUCXX OR CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(ament_cmake_python REQUIRED)
find_package(builtin_interfaces REQUIRED)
find_package(rosidl_default_generators REQUIRED)

# The message, service, and action are generated by this same ROS package.
rosidl_generate_interfaces(${PROJECT_NAME}
  "msg/RobotSnapshot.msg"
  "srv/GetRobotStatus.srv"
  "action/ObserveCamera.action"
  DEPENDENCIES builtin_interfaces
)

# Python implementation lives under a different Python module name so it can
# coexist cleanly with the generated inspection_robot_intro.msg/srv/action modules.
ament_python_install_package(ros2_intro_nodes)

install(PROGRAMS
  scripts/intro_interfaces
  scripts/robot_observer
  DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME}
)

install(DIRECTORY
  launch
  config
  worlds
  DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME}
)

install(FILES README.md DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})

if(BUILD_TESTING)
  find_package(ament_cmake_pytest REQUIRED)
  ament_add_pytest_test(test_student_helpers test/test_student_helpers.py
    APPEND_ENV PYTHONPATH=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
  )
endif()

ament_export_dependencies(rosidl_default_runtime)
ament_package()
